ConvertHybridInstance.title: Enable hybrid billing
ConvertHybridInstance.summary: Converts a subscription instance to a hybrid billing instance.

ConvertInstance.title: Switch from pay-as-you-go to subscription
ConvertInstance.summary: Converts a pay-as-you-go workspace to a subscription workspace.

ConvertPrepayInstance.title: Convert subscription to pay-as-you-go
ConvertPrepayInstance.summary: Converts a subscription instance to pay-as-you-go.

CreateInstance.title: Create a fully managed flink workspace
CreateInstance.summary: Creates a subscription or pay-as-you-go fully managed Flink workspace.

CreateNamespace.title: Create a workspace
CreateNamespace.summary: Creates a workspace in a fully managed Flink instance.

DeleteInstance.title: Release a pay-as-you-go flink workspace
DeleteInstance.summary: Releases a pay-as-you-go Realtime Compute for Apache Flink workspace.

DescribeInstances.title: View purchased fully managed flink workspaces
DescribeInstances.summary: Queries the details of one or more fully managed Flink workspaces.

DescribeNamespaces.title: View namespace details
DescribeNamespaces.summary: Queries the namespace information of a specified instance.

DescribeSupportedRegions.title: Query regions that support purchasing fully managed flink
DescribeSupportedRegions.summary: Retrieves information about regions that support purchases of fully managed Flink.

DescribeSupportedZones.title: Query zones supported by fully managed flink
DescribeSupportedZones.summary: Retrieves information about zones that are available for purchase.

GetFlinkAiService.title: Retrieve flink AI service status
GetFlinkAiService.summary: Retrieves the status of the Flink AI service.

GetFlinkAiServiceFreeQuota.title: Retrieve flink AI service free quota usage
GetFlinkAiServiceFreeQuota.summary: Retrieves the free quota usage of Flink AI services.

ListTagResources.title: List tags of a flink fully managed workspace
ListTagResources.summary: Queries resource tags. You can query tag keys by tag values, query tag values by tag keys, or retrieve all tag information used in your Flink fully managed workspace.

ModifyAiServiceProtection.title: Modify flink AI service shutdown protection status
ModifyAiServiceProtection.summary: Modifies the shutdown protection setting for a Flink AI service.

ModifyElasticResourceSpec.title: Modify pay-as-you-go resource limit for a hybrid billing instance
ModifyElasticResourceSpec.summary: Modifies the maximum pay-as-you-go resource limit for a hybrid billing instance.

ModifyInstanceSpec.title: Modify workspace resources
ModifyInstanceSpec.summary: Scales up or scales down the resources of a workspace.

ModifyInstanceVswitch.title: Modify the vSwitches of an instance
ModifyInstanceVswitch.summary: Modifies the vSwitches available to a Flink workspace.

ModifyNamespaceSpecV2.title: Modify resource configurations of a project namespace
ModifyNamespaceSpecV2.summary: Modifies the resource configurations of a project namespace in a pay-as-you-go, subscription, or hybrid billing workspace.

ModifyPrepayInstanceSpec.title: Modify workspace compute resources
ModifyPrepayInstanceSpec.summary: Modifies the compute resource specifications of a subscription Realtime Compute for Apache Flink instance. If the new specifications are smaller than the current specifications, a scale-in operation is performed. If the new specifications are larger than the current specifications, a scale-out operation is performed.

ModifyPrepayNamespaceSpec.title: Modify namespace resources
ModifyPrepayNamespaceSpec.summary: Modifies the specifications of a namespace in a subscription instance.

QueryConvertInstancePrice.title: Query pay-as-you-go to subscription conversion price
QueryConvertInstancePrice.summary: Queries the price for converting a pay-as-you-go instance to a subscription instance.

QueryConvertPrepayInstancePrice.title: Query subscription-to-pay-as-you-go conversion price
QueryConvertPrepayInstancePrice.summary: Queries the estimated refund amount after converting your Flink instance from subscription to pay-as-you-go. After the conversion, your usage is metered hourly and bills are generated accordingly.

QueryCreateInstancePrice.title: Query workspace price
QueryCreateInstancePrice.summary: Retrieves the price of a workspace for the current account.

QueryModifyInstancePrice.title: Query specification change price
QueryModifyInstancePrice.summary: Queries the price for upgrading or downgrading an instance.

QueryRenewInstancePrice.title: Query workspace renewal price
QueryRenewInstancePrice.summary: Queries the renewal price of a subscription workspace.

RenewInstance.title: Renew a realtime compute for apache flink workspace
RenewInstance.summary: Renews a subscription Realtime Compute for Apache Flink workspace.

TagResources.title: Creation of Resource Tags
TagResources.summary: Call this API to add tags to resources.
